data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 780 reported a net prior-year release in 2018. Using the comparative balance sheet figures, gross claims outstanding decreased from the prior year closing balance to the 31 December 2018 position (a release of approximately 46.6 million in the report currency). The report attributes the movement primarily to favourable claims development and reinsurance recoveries, partially offset by 2018 natural catastrophe activity (notably Hurricanes Florence and Michael) which impacted property and casualty lines.
raw_causal_phrases: movement in the syndicate's claims reserves
data.data_quality_notes: Data were extracted from scanned images. Opening reserve taken from the liabilities/technical provisions comparative column (31 Dec 2017) on the Statement of Financial Position (page ~15). No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' GROSS figure was clearly readable; prior-year development was therefore approximated as the change in gross claims outstanding between 31 Dec 2017 and 31 Dec 2018. Premium mix is provided as a single 'Reinsurance' line because the scanned segmental tables were not fully legible for reliable extraction. Amounts and LOB splits are therefore approximate and should be treated as indicative. Where exact verbatim sentences were required, a short generic sentence from the notes has been quoted as that line was visible but the detailed movement-row figures were not reliably legible.
